name: Knuckleheads
summary:
Knuckleheads is a silly physics brawler for VR. You fight with your own two arms, and so does everyone else.

Punch people. Grab people. Climb on people. Pick up a crate and throw it at people. When someone gets knocked out they go limp, so you can carry them around and toss them wherever you like.

Every punch, grab and faceplant is physics, so fights get messy fast.

**Features**

- Real VR punching. Swing harder, hit harder.
- Damage builds up until someone drops, and headshots hit twice as hard.
- Put y
